<subject>coordination with Ironstone Partners</subject>
<body>
I had a conversation with Bryan Wilson and Cynthia Calhoun this morning re: MinePlan integration and the Ironstone Partners process.

Bryan has generated both an in and out-of-the-money list which he will forward so that Perth HQ can review for counterparty termination accuracy.  I think that Ironstone Partners can use our newly established Mine & Logistics Risk protocols as a template.  Bryan and others will participate in the 9:30 a.m. conference call Feb 5.

John and Randy:  Can you provide Bryan with a copy of the "Coastal Bulk Propane, Ltd." template, or if this has been replaced, a copy of the most recent Rail & Port counterparty template?  Also, the Nexus Ore Trading template?

Kyle:  Can you provide Bryan and Meredith Green with a copy of the decision tree and settlement process flowchart?

If the handouts for tomorrow will be ready and incorporate the above, the handouts are all that Ironstone Partners will need.

Thanks.  SS

Katrina Howell
